objects.name: Analytic 2246
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol messages using vendor-specific or undocumented function codes that access device hardware registers directly rather than through the normal ICS application layer, from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
